Date March 28. 1929）

Subject (in full) Anonymous letters received by L. R. Santos.

Made by D. I. Robertson. Forwarded by J. K. Owens A. S. Pol

Since forwarding the attached report I have visited
Dr. Fischer on two occasions and have been unable to get any
further information from him except that his client has
received no further letters and is, therefore, not interested
any longer. The identity of the writer of the anonymous
letters addressed to Santos has not been discovered.

A. Robertson
D. I.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
February 23, 1929
A/D.C.I.
visited
In answer to a telephone request from Dr.
Fischer of Messrs. Johnson, Stokes & Masters will call at his office 71
Szechuen Road at 9:30 a.m. on February 27, Dr Fischer stated
that his client Mr. L.R.Santos had received three letters
dated February 2,3, and 22 respectively under the signature
of C.C.Liu and the address of P.O. Box No 477. Each of the
letters were written in the English language and were all to
the effect that the writer had lost considerable sums of
money in gambling houses owned by L.R.Santos at 5 Yates Road
and 320 Bubbling Well Road. In each of the letters the writer
demanded a loan of $1,000.00 to enable him to replace monies
which he had stolen from his employers and lost by gambling.
In the event of L.R.Santos failing to pay the sum mentioned
the writer threatened to expose him and to convey the location
of his gambling houses to the Bureau for Foreign Affairs.
Inquiries made by Dr. Fischer at the Post Office, before
he informed the Police, ascertained that P.O.Box No.477 is
rented in the name of V.C.Liu C/O the Deutsche-Asiatische Bank
and that no such person is employed in the said bank. Dr.
Fischer also came to an arrangement with the Postal Commiss-
ioner to place a man outside P.O.Box No 477 and to detain any
person found clearing it pending the arrival of the Police.
The gist of the above was verbally communicated to you
on February 27, and, acting on your instructions, I informed
Dr. Fischer that provided the letters referred to were handed
over to the Police and L.R.Santos would come forward as com-
plainant, in the event of arrest, the Police would take up the
case. To this ,however, Dr. Fischer would not agree saying
that he preferred the Deutsche-Asiatische Bank to be complain-
ants but promised to write his client for further instructions
Apparently the last thing Dr. Fischer's client desires
is publicity.
（批：This is understood but what can we do now. It seems he only wants to see the letters written. ACH 8/3.）
（签名：MCS 28.2.'29.）
（签名：H Roberts. O.I.）

（刑事侦缉处）办公室笔记
1929年2月23日
副刑事侦缉处长
到访

应强生·斯托克斯与马斯特斯律师事务所（Messrs. Johnson, Stokes & Masters）费舍尔医生的电话请求，将于2月27日上午9时30分前往其四川路71号的办公室。费舍尔医生称，其客户 L.R.桑托斯先生收到了三封信件，日期分别为2月2日、3日和22日，署名为 C.C.Liu，回邮地址为邮政信箱477号。这些信件均用英文书写，内容大致为写信人在桑托斯于耶茨路5号和静安寺路320号开设的赌窟中输掉了大笔款项。在每封信中，写信人均要求借款1,000.00美元，以便填补其从雇主处窃取并因赌博输掉的资金。如果 L.R.桑托斯不支付上述金额，写信人威胁要揭发他，并将其赌窟的位置告知外事局。

费舍尔医生在通知警方之前向邮局进行的查询证实，邮政信箱477号是以 V.C.Liu 的名义租用的，代收地址为德华银行（Deutsche-Asiatische Bank），但该银行并无此人任职。费舍尔医生还与邮政专员达成安排，在邮政信箱477号外部署人员，并在警方到达之前扣留任何被发现清理该信箱的人。

上述要点已于2月27日以口头方式向您汇报，并根据您的指示，我通知费舍尔医生，如果将所述信件移交警方，且 L.R.桑托斯作为控告人出面，警方将在逮捕发生后受理此案。然而，费舍尔医生对此表示不同意，称他更希望由德华银行作为控告人，但承诺会致信其客户以获取进一步指示。显然，费舍尔医生的客户最不希望的就是公开曝光。

（批注：这一点已了解，但我们现在能做什么呢？看来他只是想看看写的信件。ACH 3月8日。）

（签名：MCS 1929年2月28日。）

（签名：H Roberts. 情报员。）
